name: warp_boundary
title: Start and stop of each period group.

origin.description: Turns the last-of-group positions into a start and stop data frame.
origin.details: stop is warp_change with last TRUE and endpoint FALSE. start begins at 1, and each later start is the previous stop plus 1. A single date is the row 1, 1.
origin.value: A data frame with double columns start and stop.

translation.description: Turns the last-of-group positions into start and stop arrays.
translation.details: The result is a Boundary with start and stop. Both columns are 1-based doubles.
translation.value: A Boundary. start[0] is 1 and each later start is the previous stop plus 1.
